name: pw-kit
description: AI-driven Playwright + TypeScript test automation kit. 14 skills: 8 knowledge skills (locators, POM, fixtures, test-organization, forms-and-dates, assertions, test-data, api-testing), 1 tool reference (cli-tool), and 5 workflow skills (/pw-kit:new-test, /pw-kit:fix-test, /pw-kit:pre-pr, /pw-kit:create-test-cases, /pw-kit:init). Works with any modern web framework (React, Vue, Angular).

ticketPrefix.title: Ticket prefix
ticketPrefix.description: Your project tracking prefix used in test names (e.g., DEVQA, JIRA, LIN, GH). Tests will be named like 'PREFIX-12345: Description'.

appRepoPath.title: Application repository path
appRepoPath.description: Local path to the application-under-test repo. Used by /pw-kit:new-test to analyze source code for data-testid attributes, routes, and API contracts. Leave blank if the app is not in a local repo.
